create_standardize_layer: create a Standardize layer that normalizes a named array across specified axes with a given epsilon
build_layer_norm: build a LayerNorm layer with learned scale and shift parameters over named feature axes
create_rms_standardize: create an RMSStandardize layer that applies root-mean-squared standardization across named axes
build_rms_layer_norm: build an RMSLayerNorm layer with learned scale parameters using root-mean-squared standardization
test_standardize_call: test the Standardize layer by calling it with a NamedArray and axis configuration
